zh.title: Aero與Thales簽署MoU 持續發展L-39 Skyfox反無人機火箭能力
zh.summary: Aero與Thales簽署MoU；持續整合測試70公釐火箭系統
body: Aero Vodochody與Thales Belgium已簽署一份諒解備忘錄（MoU），以進一步發展L-39 Skyfox噴射機的反無人機系統（C-UAS）能力，包括持續整合測試Thales的70公釐火箭系統。
Skyfox是作為L-39NG開發、於2024年10月更名的雙座噴射教練機與輕型攻擊機，延續1968年首飛的L-39 Albatros。Aero共建造了近3,000架Albatros戰機，其中約700架仍在民用與軍用中服役。Aero在2023年4月21日首飛了第一架量產型Skyfox。
Aero的公告並未指明MoU所涵蓋的火箭型號。Thales Belgium的FZ275半主動雷射導引火箭射程為1,500至7,000公尺（約0.9至4.3英里）。在2026年6月舉行的Euros座2026上，Thales還推出了LGR275 Proxy，配備近發引信的雷射導引70毫米火箭。

en.title: Aero and Thales expand L-39 Skyfox counter-drone role with guided rockets
en.summary: Aero Vodochody and Thales Belgium sign an MoU to develop and test 70 mm rockets for the Skyfox C-UAS role.
body: Aero Vodochody and Thales Belgium have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to further develop the counter-unmanned aircraft system (C-UAS) capabilities of the L-39 Skyfox jet, including continued integration and testing of Thales’ 70 mm rocket system.

The Skyfox, developed as the L-39NG and renamed in October 2024, is a two-seat jet trainer and light combat aircraft. It succeeds the L-39 Albatros, which first flew in 1968. Aero built almost 3,000 Albatros jets, around 700 of which remain in civil and military service.

Aero’s announcement does not identify the rocket variant covered by the MoU. Thales Belgium’s FZ275 semi-active laser-guided rocket has a range of 1,500 to 7,000 meters (approximately 0.9 to 4.3 miles).

zh.title: 星宇航空臺北-吉隆坡增為每日一班 改以A330neo執飛
zh.summary: 星宇航空臺北-吉隆坡航線即日起全面增班至每日一班
body: 星宇航空今天宣佈，臺北-吉隆坡航線即日起全面增班至每日一班，並以A330neo執飛。中央社報導，鎖定轉機旅客市場，星宇航空發布新聞稿宣佈優化東南亞航網佈局。
星宇航空指出，臺北-吉隆坡航線旅運需求暢旺，機型也從A321neo改由A330neo執飛。執行長翟健華表示，這次增班與放大機型，能提供旅客更便利且舒適的飛航服務。
吉隆坡旅客可進一步經由臺北順暢轉機至洛杉磯、舊金山、加州安大略、西雅圖及鳳凰城等5大北美城市。
報導提到，吉隆坡是東南亞重要的商務、觀光及交通樞紐，亦是旅客探索馬來西亞其他城市及周遭景點的重要門戶。星宇航空指出，由吉隆坡出發的機上餐點結合娘惹、椰漿飯等當地風味。

en.title: Starlux Airlines ups Taipei-Kuala Lumpur to daily flights, switches to A330neo
en.summary: Starlux Airlines increases Taipei-Kuala Lumpur to daily service from today, operating A330neo
body: Starlux Airlines announced today that its Taipei-Kuala Lumpur route will increase to a daily service from today, operated with an A330neo, according to Central News Agency (CNA).
Targeting the transit passenger market, Starlux said the route's travel demand is strong, and the aircraft type is being changed from the A321neo to the A330neo.

Starlux chief executive officer Chai Chien-Hwa said the increase in frequency and the larger aircraft type will offer passengers more convenient and comfortable flight services, and added that passengers from Kuala Lumpur can further connect via Taipei to five North American cities including Los Angeles, San Francisco, Ontario, Seattle and Phoenix.

The report noted that Kuala Lumpur is an important business, tourism and transportation hub in Southeast Asia, also serving as a gateway for travelers to explore other cities and surrounding attractions in Malaysia. Starlux said meals served on board routes from Kuala Lumpur incorporate local flavors such as nasi lemak and Nyonya cuisine.
